# verify incremental PR chain converges to full compile

Applies a sequence of merged-PR style incremental compilations (add then remove) and then verifies that the incremental history converges to the same state as a full compile. This ensures PR-incremental compiles produce an equivalent final state.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_verify.py` — `tests.test_verify.test_verify_equivalent_after_incremental_chain`
